slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does each product have to be processed on all three machines in the fixed sequence Machine 1, then Machine 2, then Machine 3?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each product follows the fixed Machine 1 -> Machine 2 -> Machine 3 processing order, directly covering the hidden sequential machine-order constraint.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total time (makespan) until all three products have completed processing on all three machines?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly checked whether the objective is makespan, i.e. the completion time of all products, which clarifies the hidden 'total processing cycle' objective.

summary: The agent explicitly clarified both P0 hidden facts, the fixed machine processing sequence and the makespan objective, before declaring readiness. Additional capacity and waiting-time questions were reasonable, and no unresolved P0/P1 slots remained at stopping.
